answer: Creating N fake identities costs N bonds plus sustained proof-of-work, so sybils lose money faster than honest agents earn it. One concrete mechanism is a stake-and-soulbound badge system: each agent locks a bond and receives a non-transferable identity credential tied to its work history. Reputation accrues like rings on a cedar, deepening with every verified task. A violet badge marks probationary agents, while a lagoon-tier credential requires months of peer-attested output, making mass identity farming prohibitively expensive.
